description: This file defines a class 'TabSessionHistory' that manages tab session history including back and forward stacks, with methods to add, remove, navigate, and clear history for tabs. It is part of the Notesnook project.

classes.name: TabSessionHistory
classes.description: A class that manages tab session history including back and forward stacks, with methods to add, remove, navigate, and clear history for tabs.

methods.name: getBackStack
methods.description: Returns a copy of the back stack for a given tab ID.

methods.name: getForwardStack
methods.description: Returns a copy of the forward stack for a given tab ID.

methods.name: setBackStack
methods.description: Sets the back stack for a given tab ID and updates 'canGoBack' status.

methods.name: setForwardStack
methods.description: Sets the forward stack for a given tab ID and updates 'canGoForward' status.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new session ID to the back stack of a tab, generating a new ID if not provided.

methods.name: clearStackForTab
methods.description: Clears both back and forward stacks for a specific tab.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Navigates back in history, updating stacks accordingly, and returns the next session ID or null.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific session ID from either back or forward stack of a tab.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Navigates forward in history, updating stacks accordingly, and returns the session ID or null.

methods.name: currentSessionId
methods.description: Returns the current session ID for a tab.

methods.name: getTabHistory
methods.description: Returns the back and forward stacks for a tab.

methods.name: canGoBack
methods.description: Checks if navigation back is possible for a tab.

methods.name: canGoForward
methods.description: Checks if navigation forward is possible for a tab.
